concept.title: Development and contributing
concept.shortdesc: The plugin is open source under Apache-2.0; design decisions, requirements, and the gap analysis live alongside the code.

ul.li: org.istanduk.gov-uk/ — the plugin itself: transtype declaration, Ant glue, XSLT overrides, and vendored govuk-frontend assets
design/ — the full design record: context, requirements with per-item status, architecture, component inventory, decision log, and the Open Referral UK gap analysis
fixtures/ — the regression fixture exercising bookmaps, keys, chunking, and the SVG domain

conbody.p: Continuous integration builds this manual and the fixture on every push, validates the HTML with the Nu validator, and asserts the neutral-branding guarantees — no fonts, no crown imagery, no external asset requests in the output.
The architecture in one sentence: a standard DITA-OT plugin whose govuk transformation extends html5, overriding only the rendering while inheriting all of the toolkit's DITA processing.
conbody.note: Issues and pull requests are welcome. Check the design folder's open questions and the issue tracker before proposing large changes — many decisions are already recorded with their rationale.
